sources.label: SneakerPing homepage (verified 2026-09-12)
sources.claim: SneakerPing is a sneaker price-alert service: it watches StockX, GOAT, eBay, and 40+ online stores and pings the buyer when a tracked pair drops to their target price, with SMS, email, and Discord notifications and a free tier that watches 5 pairs with no credit card.

sources.label: Sneaker Resale Market Report 2026 (SneakerPing, verified 2026-09-12)
sources.claim: SneakerPing's published study of 3,538 sneaker releases between August 2024 and August 2026 reports 59.5% most recently sold below retail, with a median 10.6% under retail; figures are as of 18 August 2026 and are based on recorded sale prices.
